thread:
Maria Chen: MirrorLake just paused signoff. Their CISO wants a BYO-KMS attestation (including HSM support) + an explicit egress cap line in the pilot SOW before the CIO will ok the pilot. Can we assemble a bridge pack by EOD tomorrow?

Leo Ortiz: Got it. They also flagged throughput: asking for sustained ~1500 embeddings req/s with p95 < 80ms. Our Dedicated config might hit that with 2x A100 nodes + aggressive batching, but we should validate.

Devon Park: We can design a 2-node reserved cluster with dynamic batching and KV caching. Need to run a short load bench to verify tail latencies. I'll queue a run tomorrow. @OpsBot please schedule.

Anya Kuznetsova: For the attestation: customer needs key rotation policy, supported KMS vendors, and proof we can accept customer-owned keys. I'll draft a 1-page attestation template referencing AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, and partner HSM. Need product signoff on rotation cadence (we typically recommend 90 days).

Kate Morales: Commercial ask: MirrorLake wants an egress cap and a pilot discount. Proposal idea: 4-week pilot, $30k trial credit, egress cap $5k for the pilot period, and an optional conversion incentive (first month waived if they commit to Dedicated within 30 days). Legal may want the cap as a line item in SOW.

Maria Chen: Execs want an internal owner on the customer bridge. We need one from presales, one from infra, one from commercial, and our exec to join. Who can commit to the 10am PT slot tomorrow?

Leo Ortiz: I can run the presales demo. @Anya will cover KMS/attestation. @Devon will present perf numbers and mitigation plan. Kate handles SOW/pricing. Maria, can you cover exec intro?

Anya Kuznetsova: I'll draft the attestation + answer the security questionnaire items. MirrorLake sent a 28-question security sheet (see link: https://mirrorlake.share/sec-q-28). Please put any clarifying Qs in a single doc in the opp.

Devon Park: OpsBot 999please run perf test against staging model with these params and post results in thread:
```
model: rwd-inf-embed-2
concurrency: 128
seq_len: 512
duration: 300s
batching: fixed-64
```

OpsBot: Perf test scheduled for 2023-10-05 02:30 UTC. Results will be posted to #eng-runtime and linked here after completion.

Kate Morales: I'll draft the pilot SOW and include the egress cap line, trial credit, and an exec-level escalation clause (4-hour response SLA during pilot). Should we include a short EU data residency paragraph for their EEA workloads? Maria?

Maria Chen: Yes add EU data residency language and ask Legal to pre-approve the PII handling clause. Also include a 99.5% uptime objective for the pilot and an explicit rollback/fallback plan if we can't meet throughput.

Leo Ortiz: For the bridge invite: propose 10am PT. I will send calendar invite to MirrorLake CIO, CISO, CTO + our execs. I'll attach a one-pager summarizing: pilot duration, throughput commitment, BYO-KMS attestation ETA, egress cap, trial credit.

Anya Kuznetsova: I'll attach the attestation draft to the invite and add a short FAQ about KMS key rotation and HSM support.

Devon Park: After the perf run I'll post p50/p95/p99 latencies, GPU utilization, and mem stats. If p95 is above 80ms we can propose a short-term burst plan (add a third node during peak windows) for the pilot.

Kate Morales: Commercial tweak: if they convert to a 6-month reserved commit within 45 days, we can upgrade egress cap and provide a one-time onboarding credit. I'll add both options in SOW as convertible incentives.

Maria Chen: Action owners: Leo (send invite + demo), Anya (attestation + security QA), Devon (perf run + post results), Kate (SOW + pricing). OpsBot scheduled. We need all artifacts attached before the bridge.

Leo Ortiz: Posting invite in 15m. Please respond in-thread with any redlines to the attestation or SOW so we can consolidate before customer call.

Anya Kuznetsova: Quick note 999re rotation policy: will recommend 90-day rotation with audit logs; call out that rotation schedule can be customer-managed when they BYO-KMS.

Devon Park: Aiming to have bench summary posted within 4 hours of the run. If we see memory pressure we'll recommend sequence-length caps for the pilot.

Kate Morales: I'll also loop in Legal for the egress cap phrasing.

Maria Chen: Thanks team 999if we land these pieces before the bridge we should get provisional CIO signoff. Follow up in the invite thread. :white_check_mark:
